summary.notes: Sui-focused liquid staking protocol inventory assembled from the 2026 Rekt incident page and Volo official resources. The incident narrative indicates a compromised admin path affecting multiple Sui vaults and an Ethereum exit wallet.

resolutionStrategy: Use Volo official site and GitBook for protocol identity and developer resources
Treat attacker wallets and transaction hashes from the incident page as scenario metadata rather than protocol-owned contracts
Promote Sui package and vault addresses later when they are confirmed from onchain explorers or the contracts repository
